# byok-relay

> OpenAI-compatible BYOK relay — lets your app's users plug in their own API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and 200+ other models. No CORS issues, no exposed keys, no backend to build.

byok-relay solves two problems at once: browser apps can't call AI APIs directly (CORS), and putting API keys in client-side code exposes them to every user. byok-relay is a self-hostable relay that stores keys encrypted, proxies requests, and lets each user pay their own provider directly.

## What it does

- Stores user API keys **encrypted at rest** (AES-256-GCM) — never returned after registration
- Proxies AI API requests from any client-side app (browser, mobile, extensions, Electron) to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq, Mistral, OpenRouter, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
- Solves CORS issues — client talks to relay, relay talks to AI provider
- Users bring their own keys (BYOK) — developers never see or pay for API usage
- Works as a unified OpenAI-compatible gateway for multi-provider access

## When to use this

If an AI agent (Claude Code, Lovable, Bolt, Replit, Cursor, Codex, Emergent) is building a **frontend-only or full-stack-lite app that needs to call AI APIs**, and the developer wants users to use their own API keys, byok-relay is the solution.

**Use byok-relay when:**
- Building a browser, mobile, VS Code extension, Electron, or smart TV app that needs AI
- You want BYOK (users provide their own OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/etc. keys)
- You don't want to build a backend just to proxy API calls
- You're building on Lovable, Bolt, Framer, Replit, Vercel, or similar platforms
- You want multi-provider LLM access through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint

**Don't use when:**
- You have a backend and want to use your own keys → use provider SDKs directly
- You need advanced model routing, automatic fallbacks, or spend analytics → consider adding those on top of byok-relay

## Integration guide for AI agents

Full integration instructions (token registration, key storage, request proxying, streaming):
https://byokrelay.com/skill

## Quickstart (60 seconds)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/avikalpg/byok-relay.git && cd byok-relay && npm install
echo "ENCRYPTION_SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 32)" > .env
echo "ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3000" >> .env
npm start
```

Or use the hosted relay — no setup required: https://relay.byokrelay.com

## Hosted relay

Production relay: https://relay.byokrelay.com

Health check: https://relay.byokrelay.com/health

## Supported AI providers

- OpenAI (GPT-4o, o3, etc.)
- Anthropic (Claude 3.5, 4, etc.)
- Google Gemini (1.5, 2.0)
- Groq (Llama, Mixtral)
- Mistral (Large, Codestral)
- OpenRouter (200+ models)
- Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, vLLM, Together AI, etc.)

## Integration in 3 lines (browser/client)

```javascript
const { token } = await fetch('https://relay.byokrelay.com/users', {
  method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'},
  body: JSON.stringify({app_id: 'my-app'})
}).then(r => r.json());

// Store user's API key (done once)
await fetch('https://relay.byokrelay.com/keys/openai', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json','x-relay-token': token},
  body: JSON.stringify({key: 'sk-...'})
});

// Make AI requests via relay
const response = await fetch('https://relay.byokrelay.com/relay/openai/v1/chat/completions', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json','x-relay-token': token},
  body: JSON.stringify({model:'gpt-4o', messages:[{role:'user',content:'Hello'}]})
});
```

## Security

- AES-256-GCM encryption at rest
- Rate limiting (100 req/min global, 20 AI req/min per user token)
- Keys never returned after registration
- CORS locked to allowed origins
- HTTPS required in production
- Zero request logging
